title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3055 (AKU HT 67925)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3055

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 67925

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 67925; AKU grapheme U0010 (AKU GR 639). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: U2 (std), U1 (var). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 469. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 8; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 4.2 x 15.6 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Dritte Zwischenzeit, 22.–23. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
